summary: Vikunja is a self-hosted task management platform designed to help you track to-do lists and organise daily projects. It provides a central interface for planning personal or collaborative work items. The backend is written in Go and distributed under open source licences.
goodFor: It suits individuals or teams seeking an independent, self-hosted task tracker that avoids third-party cloud services.
watchOut: You may find it overlaps significantly with mature, well-known project management alternatives, and its feature set depends on how you choose to configure and maintain the instance.
deployNotes: As a Go application, it typically compiles into a single binary that requires a separate database like PostgreSQL or MySQL, alongside a reverse proxy for TLS termination and persistent storage for user data.
